services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive maritime medical services designed to keep your crew healthy and your vessels compliant with international regulations.
services.medicalChestsDesc: Complete medical chest solutions tailored to your vessel type and flag state requirements. We supply, manage, and maintain medical chests that meet all international and national maritime health regulations. Our inventory management system ensures nothing expires and everything is accounted for.
services.supplyFeature1: Custom-configured medical chests per flag state standards
services.supplyFeature2: Automated inventory tracking and expiry management
services.supplyFeature3: Worldwide delivery to any port of call
services.recertificationDesc: Regular inspection and recertification of onboard medical equipment and supplies. Our certified inspectors ensure your vessel meets all regulatory requirements, with detailed reports and timely renewal scheduling.
services.recertFeature3: Automated renewal reminders and certification tracking
services.pharmaceuticalsDesc: Genuine, quality-assured pharmaceuticals sourced from licensed suppliers. We provide a complete range of medications required by maritime regulations, with proper cold chain logistics and documentation.
services.pharmaFeature2: Cold chain logistics for temperature-sensitive items
services.medicalEquipmentDesc: Supply and maintenance of medical equipment from AEDs to diagnostic devices. All equipment is regularly calibrated and maintained to manufacturer specifications.
services.equipFeature1: AEDs, diagnostic equipment, and emergency devices
services.oxygenServicesDesc: Complete medical oxygen solutions including cylinder supply, hydrostatic testing, refilling, and exchange services. We ensure your oxygen equipment is always ready for emergencies.
services.oxyFeature3: Oxygen system maintenance and spare parts
services.telemedicalDesc: 24/7 access to qualified medical professionals via satellite communication. Our telemedical service provides real-time medical guidance for onboard emergencies, routine consultations, and pre-embarkation assessments.
services.drugAlcoholDesc: Comprehensive testing programs to meet port state and company policies. We provide test kits, collection services, and laboratory analysis with certified chain of custody.
services.mentalHealthDesc: Dedicated mental health programs for maritime professionals. We provide counseling services, awareness training, and wellness resources to support seafarer wellbeing at sea.
services.reflaggingDesc: Seamless transition of medical supplies when changing flag states. We manage the entire process of updating medical inventories to meet new regulatory requirements.
services.reflagFeature1: Gap analysis between current and target flag state
services.ctaDesc: Every vessel is unique. Contact us for a customized service package that meets your specific requirements.

about.title: About Say-Med
about.subtitle: Dedicated to maritime health and safety for over two decades. We are your trusted partner in vessel medical compliance.
about.storyTitle: A Legacy of Maritime Medical Excellence
about.storyP1: Founded with a mission to improve healthcare at sea, Say-Med has grown from a specialized maritime pharmacy into a comprehensive medical supply and services provider serving the global shipping industry.
about.storyP2: Our team combines deep maritime expertise with medical knowledge, enabling us to understand the unique challenges of providing healthcare in the demanding ocean environment. We work closely with flag state authorities, classification societies, and shipping companies worldwide.
about.storyP3: Today, we serve thousands of vessels across 120+ countries, providing everything from medical chest supply to telemedical advisory services. Our commitment to quality, compliance, and seafarer welfare drives everything we do.
about.missionDesc: To ensure every seafarer has access to quality medical care and supplies by providing maritime companies with compliant, reliable, and comprehensive medical solutions.
about.visionDesc: To be the global standard in maritime medical supply and services, recognized for innovation, reliability, and an unwavering commitment to seafarer health.
about.value1Desc: Crew safety is at the heart of everything we do. We never compromise on quality or compliance.
about.value2Desc: Our worldwide network ensures reliable service in any port, any time zone, any weather.
about.value3Desc: Behind every order is a crew that depends on us. We treat every delivery as critical.
about.value4Desc: Continuous improvement in processes, products, and services. ISO-certified quality management.
about.ctaDesc: Partner with Say-Med for reliable maritime medical solutions.
